setup.title: Connect NectarLink
setup.intro: The plugin is installed. Phone features need the separate NectarLink application with this integration's extended API.
setup.install: 1. Install and start the extended-API NectarLink fork.
setup.api: 2. In the application's settings, enable Local automation API.
setup.pair: 3. Add your phone in NectarLink and confirm pairing on both devices.
setup.source_note: How to install opens the guide for NectarLink for Noctalia.
setup.credentials_missing: Connection is not configured yet. Start the application and enable its API. If already enabled, check the user profile and file permissions.
setup.credentials_invalid: Connection settings could not be read correctly. Check the application and profile; do not delete your profile or copy someone else's token.
setup.api_unavailable: Cannot reach the application. Check that it is running, then check the connection again.
setup.unauthorized: The application rejected authorization. Make sure both programs run as the same user with the same profile, then check again.
setup.auth_changed: Connection settings changed. Checking the new connection; check the phone before retrying any previously pending action.
setup.no_devices: Application connected, but no phones were returned. Add or check your phone in NectarLink.
setup.unsupported: This API route is unavailable. Check that the extended-API fork is running, not an ordinary upstream build.
setup.invalid_response: The application returned an incompatible response. Check the application build using the installation help.
setup.permission: The application denied access. Check feature permissions and settings; this response alone does not identify the cause.
setup.timeout: Connection check timed out. Check that the application is running, then try checking again.

pages.retry_hint: Check the connection and Android permissions. Use Refresh at the top right to read again.
pages.loading_hint: The first read may take a few seconds. Other sections are available on the left.

photos.no_thumbnail: No thumbnail received. You can download the original.

apps.open_window: Open app in a separate window

confirm.title: Confirm: {action}
confirm.target: This action runs on the selected phone or PC.

cache.saved: Saved data; use the button on the right to refresh

home.select_recipient: With multiple phones, select the recipient in the app
home.screen_hint: Open or close the separate phone-screen window
home.clipboard_hint: Send clipboard text to the phone
home.transport_only: Sent. Draft retained — check text entry on the phone.
home.webcam_hint: Start or stop the virtual camera; drivers are not installed by the plugin
home.typing_hint: Enable text entry on the selected phone
home.notifications_hint: Show all notifications in the app

controls.title: Phone controls
controls.update_required: An updated NectarLink build is required
controls.hotspot_hint: Choose on or off; the phone does not report its state
controls.wifi_confirmation: Turn off Wi-Fi? Connection may be lost.

sessions.watch_hint: Play a video on the PC first; the phone may ask for confirmation

auth_changed.title: API settings changed
auth_changed.body: Checking the new connection. Old replies were discarded; an action may have arrived. Check the phone before retrying.

credentials_missing.title: API file unavailable
credentials_missing.body: Start the extended-API NectarLink build and enable its API. If already enabled, check the profile and file permissions.

credentials_invalid.title: Invalid API settings
credentials_invalid.body: The API file failed validation. Check the app and profile; do not delete the profile or use someone else's token.

api_unavailable.title: Cannot reach the app
api_unavailable.body: Check that NectarLink is running and its local API is enabled, then refresh.

unauthorized.title: Authorization rejected
unauthorized.body: Check that the app runs as the same user with the same profile. Refresh rereads the token.

unsupported.title: API feature unavailable
unsupported.body: Route not found. The extended-API fork is required. The help button opens its installation guide.

invalid_response.title: Unexpected API response
invalid_response.body: The response format is incompatible. Check the app build; invalid responses do not replace saved data.

permission.title: Feature access denied
permission.body: Check feature settings and permissions in NectarLink and Android. HTTP 403 alone does not identify the cause.

phone_offline.title: Phone is offline
phone_offline.body: Check the phone connection in NectarLink and its Android permissions. Saved data may be out of date.

timeout.title: Response timed out
timeout.body: Check the connection and refresh. If an action was pending, check its result on the phone first; it is not retried automatically.

request_failed.title: Request failed
request_failed.body: Check the connection and feature settings. Refresh rereads data; actions are never retried automatically.

notifications.auth_changed: API settings changed during an action. Its result is unknown; check the phone/PC before retrying.
notifications.absolute_path: Set an absolute executable path or leave the field empty
notifications.launch_failed: Could not start NectarLink. Check the path and execute permission; run it in a terminal to diagnose missing libraries.
notifications.browser_failed: Could not open the browser. Fork address: {url}
notifications.action_timeout: No confirmation. Check the phone/PC before retrying; there is no automatic retry.
notifications.session_timeout: No reply to session control. Checking its state.
notifications.type_timeout: No confirmation of delivery. Text remains in the field; there is no automatic retry.
notifications.toggle_timeout: No reply to the toggle request. Checking its state.
notifications.camera_timeout: No reply to the camera request
notifications.ring_timeout: No reply. Checking the phone state.
notifications.action_failed: Action unconfirmed. Check the phone/PC before retrying.
notifications.action_limit: Action not sent. Restart the NectarLink app to reset its action limit.
notifications.action_busy: Action not sent. NectarLink is still handling another action.
notifications.another_device: Another phone is using this session
notifications.nothing_playing: Play a video on the computer first
notifications.invalid_json: Request format error between the plugin and API
notifications.invalid_session: The API did not recognize the session type
notifications.no_device: The phone is unavailable to the API
notifications.session_failed: The app could not start the session
notifications.api_unavailable: Cannot reach the local NectarLink API
notifications.type_failed: Delivery unconfirmed. Text retained; check the phone before retrying — some text may have arrived.
notifications.toggle_failed: Toggle request unconfirmed. Checking the phone state.
notifications.ring_failed: The phone did not accept the request

widget.title: Bar widget
widget.body: Click NectarLink in the Noctalia bar to open this panel. Icons on the left switch sections.

home.title: Home — quick actions
home.body: The top card shows the phone and battery. Below are screen, files, clipboard, ring and camera actions; controls and timeline are on the right.

settings.title: Make it yours
settings.body: The bottom-left gear opens plugin settings: battery, device name, offline visibility and Home sections.

messages.title: Messages and calls
messages.body: Select a conversation; the plus-message icon creates an SMS. Sending and dialing require confirmation. Drafts remain until cleared or the plugin reloads.

photos.title: Photos and apps
photos.body: Choose an album, open a thumbnail and download the original. Apps launch on click; choose the grid layout in plugin settings.

deck.title: Deck and pages
deck.body: Deck runs a configured tile immediately on click. Bottom arrows turn pages; Refresh at the top rereads the current section.

connection.title: No connection or disabled action
connection.body: Start NectarLink and enable its local API. Check the network, Android permissions and device feature switches, then refresh.

history.title: Missing chat history
history.body: Chats show saved notifications, not full messenger archives. Replies require an active notification; SMS needs a separate phone permission.

unconfirmed.title: Action unconfirmed
unconfirmed.body: Check the phone/PC first: the request may have arrived. The plugin never resends automatically or clears an unconfirmed draft. Screen and webcam need Android permissions.

navigation.title: Returning to a section
navigation.body: Search, page, conversation and album are remembered per phone. Saved content appears immediately while its cache entry remains available.

refresh.title: Refresh without a blank view
refresh.body: A refresh icon means a background read; a clock means saved data. Failed refreshes keep it visible. The right-hand button forces a read when connected.

reload.title: When data loads again
reload.body: The bounded cache lives in memory only. Restarting, changing authorization or evicting an entry requires another read. Confirmations and actions are never restored.

fork.title: Extended-API build required
fork.body: The upstream build cannot replace the fork's page/control API. The book icon opens the NectarLink for Noctalia installation guide.

niri.title: Niri: Island intercepts clicks
niri.body: The Noctalia build retains the original Island. The separate NectarLink for Niri project documents the workaround; no compositor replacement is needed.

checks.title: Where to start
checks.body: Check the app is running, API enabled, phone connected and permissions granted. Set an absolute executable path if needed. Keep your profile and token private.
